title: One Path, One Lesson at a Time
changes: The Journey dashboard now presents one guided path with a clearly identified current lesson and the next steps ahead.
Lesson progress now refreshes immediately so completing one individual lesson reveals the next lesson in sequence.
Removed the Activity Skills map and free-practice surface from the main Journey; activities can be introduced contextually when they reinforce learning.
The daily route is now one next lesson instead of a fixed three-step routine, so each lesson can introduce connected words and sentence-building naturally.
Ordinary activities are available as optional practice without unlock gates; the boss-style Memory Dojo remains gated.
Removed the regional journey panel so the step-by-step lesson path is the main view.
A repeated topic lesson reuses the exact same words as the attempt that needed another pass, so it's genuinely the same lesson again, not a new pick of words.
Activity landmarks now clearly explain that they join your main journey automatically as side quests when you're ready — no separate browsing or unlocking needed.
The old 'Activity Skills' grid is now a collapsed, clearly optional 'Free practice' section for extra reps outside your main path, instead of sitting alongside it as an equal, separate choice.
A new 'Your journey ahead' list on the Journey screen shows the upcoming topics in order, alongside the existing 'Learning history' timeline of where you've already been.
